title: fix(app-shell): the permission-set pages read the confirm label, clone source, ledger row and Add refusal by the holder they show
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuH3CaUnJoKaVub6XpDPzQdD)_

Fixes #32774

## 维护者速读

- 问题：#32769 之后，权限集页面在同名有多个持有者时仍有几处按名字取值：确认框标签、两个克隆入口、不带包的授权、单候选选择后的台账、Add 被拒时的候选、编辑器的已发布列表、计数说明。
- 改法：页面已知持有者的地方，一律按（包，名）取值；确认框写出所切换的持有者；克隆带上所示持有者的包；Add 被 409 拒绝且带候选时弹出与其它门一样的持有者选择。
- 不归任何持有者的授权（两个包持有该名、授权没指明其中任何一个）另列为"未归属"，可移除，不计入任何持有者，也不按顺序归给谁。
- 一个持有者（CONTROL）：请求与界面不变；每项一个 pin，12 处消融全部变红，恢复后字节一致。
- 只改 `@object-ui/app-shell`，不动服务端，没有放宽任何安全或权限行为；没有新增 i18n 键（文案沿用已有键或该组件内的本地文案）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：席位（domain:ui#6）审过。专题席红线复读 PASS-with-nits（6834657181）：「未归属」区只按该行自己的授权 id 删、不计数、不归属；Add 只在服务端拒绝并给出完整候选时弹选择，不替人选。复读后的提交只把授予写入留回 addUsers 以满足写入点普查，行为不变。主干类型检查堆溢出（#32794）已由 #32801 修好，本 PR 已更新分支。6 条 nit 转跟进卡 #32807。CI 绿后按队列落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

Where a Setup or Studio page lists more than one holder of a permission-set name (ADR-0150 D3/D5/D8), the readings PR #32769 left by name now go by `(package, name)`. A name with one holder, and the environment's own set, are read and written by the name exactly as before.

| # | Item (card body 1–6, comment 6830813754 7–9) | Verdict on `main` `ee230a25` | Change | Pin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `labelOf` takes the first row of a name; the confirm never names the package | holds | `labelOf(name, holding)` picks the switched holder's row; `DeactivateConfirmDialog` adds one line naming the holder (`perm.holder.pick.package` / `.environment`, existing keys) | `ResourceListPage.environmentScope-7611.test.tsx` › objectstack#32774 item 1 (+ CONTROL) |
| 2 | Neither clone host passes `sourcePackage` | holds | the editor passes `holdingPackage(assignmentsHolding)`; Studio's "New similar" gets the same package through a new `studio.onCloneSourceRead` callback | `PermissionMatrixEditor.holderReads-32774.test.tsx` item 2; `StudioDesignSurface.accessNewSimilar-28573.test.tsx` › objectstack#32774 case (the existing post-shape case is its CONTROL) |
| 3 | A package-less grant under two package holders is listed under neither | holds | `AssignedUsersSection` lists grants `storedGrantHolders` reads as no holder's in an "Unresolved grants" block, with Remove; not counted, not in either holder's rows | `AssignedUsersSection.holderReads-32774.test.tsx` item 3 (+ CONTROL); the #32537 pin in `AssignedUsersSection.test.tsx` now asserts the row is in that block |
| 4 | Stale "ONE holder per deployment" comment | holds | comment rewritten (ADR-0150 D5, `holdingOfRead`) | none (comment only) |
| 5 | After a one-candidate pick, `ledgerAfterSwitch` updates only the by-name state | holds | `ledgerAfterSwitch` takes the holding: records the `(package, name)` row whenever one is held, and the by-name state where the page reads by name | `permission-set-holder.byNameReads-32774.test.ts` item 5 (+ CONTROL) |
| 6 | `holderCandidatesOf` reads only the wrapped body; Add reads only the message | holds | `holderCandidatesOf` reads the wrapped and the flat body; new `holderCandidatesOfError` reads the client's `err.code` / `err.details`; a refused Add opens `PermissionSetHolderPick` and re-sends with the chosen holder's `permission_set_package` | `permission-set-holder.byNameReads-32774.test.ts` item 6; `AssignedUsersSection.holderReads-32774.test.tsx` item 6 (+ CONTROL) |
| 7 | The editor's published list is fetched once per client | holds | re-read with the set (`publishNonce`, `reloadNonce`); the mount still sends one read | `PermissionMatrixEditor.holderReads-32774.test.tsx` item 7 |
| 8 | The environment's section counts A's shipped positions without saying so | holds | count unchanged (accepted over-count); the section says it may count more, never fewer, where a listed position may be another holder's | `AssignedUsersSection.holderReads-32774.test.tsx` item 8 (+ CONTROL) |
| 9 | No pin covers `?package=sys_metadata` → environment | holds | pin only, no code change | `permission-set-holder.byNameReads-32774.test.ts` item 9 |

No item was struck: each still held on `main` at `ee230a25`.

## Why

PR #32769's epic red-line reads (6829073582, 6830782363) left these as nits for a follow-up. They become visible once #31698 PR-2 lets a second package hold a permission-set name.

## Verification

- vitest: the 14 suites over the touched files, 156 tests, all pass.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` (both programs): exit 0.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the 13 changed TS files: 0 errors.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` on the committed head: 36 derived commands, each run with its exit code recorded; `--ran` reconciled (see the os-dev-report on #32774).
- Ablation, one per behaviour pin: reverting only the fix turns the pin red (12 of 12), and the restored file equals HEAD.

## Acceptance notes

- Studio's `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` change is the clone host only: a `newSimilarSource` state fed by the matrix's new `onCloneSourceRead` callback, passed as the dialog's `sourcePackage`.
- Item 7: the published list is now also read again on a publish and on the draft guard's reload; the first mount sends the same single read as before.
- Item 3's block uses generic primitives only (`Button`, the existing list markup); its copy, like the item 8 note, lives in the section's own local copy table, so no `@object-ui/i18n` key is added.
- Branch is the card thread's `claude/project-thread-oo71jb` (restated claim 6832591103).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; eslint `--no-inline-config` on the changed files has 0 errors (the full `pnpm lint` is left to CI).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 section is the seat's required Chinese summary).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
